speaker: Doctor
text: You’re experiencing postmenopausal bleeding and have an adnexal mass—how long has this been going on, and are you having any pelvic pain or bloating?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any abdominal distension or early satiety, and have you noticed any changes in your urinary frequency or stool habits? I will also request a pelvic ultrasound to better characterize the adnexal mass and assess the endometrial thickness.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Intermittent bleeding from the vagina. I also have No recent weight loss, No fever, No changes in bladder or bowel habits. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Pelvic_Ultrasound
REQUEST TEST: Endometrial_Biopsy
Given your age and symptoms, we must urgently rule out endometrial cancer or ovarian malignancy, so I have ordered these tests to guide our next steps.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Pelvic Ultrasound: Thickened endometrial stripe and left adnexal mass observed; Endometrial Biopsy: Well-differentiated adenocarcinoma

speaker: Doctor
text:
The biopsy confirms well-differentiated endometrial adenocarcinoma, which explains the bleeding. The adnexal mass raises concern for ovarian involvement or a synchronous primary tumor.
REQUEST TEST: CA-125

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal CA-125 is reassuring, but we must still stage the cancer to see if it has spread. I will request imaging to assess for metastasis. REQUEST IMAGES

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Non-smoker, does not consume alcohol, retired school teacher.
